nodes.label: Recitation-flavor bleed
nodes.rationale: The failure mode the project must avoid — the AR reproducing learned recitation statistics instead of the target style.

nodes.label: YuE2 generation/merge knobs investigation
nodes.rationale: Investigation and design only — no training, no GPU generation, no code changes; a read-only analysis of audio.cpp knobs against two failure modes.

nodes.label: CFG two-stream AR mechanism
nodes.rationale: When guidance_scale != 1.0 the pipeline runs positive (style+lyrics) and negative (instruction-only) streams and combines logits as neg + (pos-neg)*g; both use the same merged weights so guidance cannot cancel the pron adapter.

nodes.label: backup_to_gcp.py GCS mirror
nodes.rationale: Colab storage is ephemeral; bias toward persisting anything expensive to regenerate to GCS.

nodes.label: agent_notes/current.md handoff surface
nodes.rationale: User drives via vscode.dev where copying chat text is glitchy, so current.md is the overwritten-each-write copy surface; it is git-ignored but GCS-mirrored.

nodes.label: AGENTS.md agent operating contract
nodes.rationale: Scopes the agent to problem-solver-on-call only: prepare a run, report how it is going from real data, diagnose crashes, and hand over exact commands.

nodes.label: Reconciliation log
nodes.rationale: Dated records of docs changes (file, what-and-why, authority), one entry per pass.

nodes.label: unverifiable.txt external-token allowlist
nodes.rationale: Hand-curated allowlist of tokens that legitimately resolve outside the repo; a broad glob silently hides real drift.

nodes.label: SOURCE_OF_TRUTH.md
nodes.rationale: One authority per topic; when two documents disagree the higher row wins, history files are authoritative only for the past.

nodes.label: Auto-resume exception policy
nodes.rationale: Agent may resume without the user only when the run had human approval, stopped unplanned, and is resumed with identical config and run name — so the user need not retype a command.

nodes.label: Colab ephemeral runtime, storage is cheap
nodes.norm_label: colab ephemeral runtime, storage is cheap
nodes.rationale: Losing the VM wipes /content; only GitHub + GCS persist, so persist cheaply and aggressively.

nodes.label: Branch-specific graph caveat
nodes.rationale: Graph reflects the commit it was built at and is branch-specific; the 2026-09-25 build has known dangling-endpoint edges and one self-loop.

nodes.label: Map, not the territory
nodes.rationale: The graph is used to find structure and connections but the real files must still be opened before editing.

nodes.label: ai-toolkit auto-resume trap
nodes.rationale: ai-toolkit auto-resumes from the latest checkpoint in the run's output folder — wanted after a pause, a trap when meaning to start over.

nodes.label: Frozen-doc exemption
nodes.rationale: Frozen/history docs (e.g. IMPROVEMENTS.md, investigation.md) are never rewritten even when stale; only live docs are reconciled.
